# FindBuyAgent

> Non-custodial agent payments on Base with x402. A marketplace of 480 live-verified paid APIs, and one-time burner budgets run by GitHub Actions.

## Marketplace
- [Index (JSON)](https://blockchains.github.io/findbuyagent/marketplace/index.json): every listed service with price, category, payment type, endpoint, last verification, uptime and rating
- Per-service JSON: https://blockchains.github.io/findbuyagent/marketplace/<slug>.json (endpoint, method, input/output schema, payee, curl example, check history)
- [Live data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/findbuyagent-vault/main/market/market.json), refreshed three times a day
- Payment: every service below is x402 (USDC on Base) unless marked otherwise; only x402 ones are auto-bought by budgets
- Rate a service: POST https://api.github.com/repos/Blockchains/findbuyagent-vault/issues with title "Rating: <slug>" and body {"slug":"<slug>","stars":1-5}
